papers.title_en: Low-Bit Recurrent States in Hybrid Language Models
papers.evidence: 循环状态低比特量化与混合精度比特分配
papers.tldr: 混合语言模型用固定大小循环状态，但现有量化器常需8比特以上，量化误差还会按通道衰减率残留。本文从可观测Gramian推导失真权重，结合归一化状态范围做混合精度比特分配，无需校准、旋转或训练，并对衰减率对数量化。在三个混合模型上，逐token量化以4比特平均载荷把超额负对数似然较七种基线最优者降低3.3–27.9倍；6比特时与FP32状态基线差距小于0.005 nats。消融区分了可变位宽、衰减加权与范围归一化的增益，为低比特循环状态提供无训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid language models maintain fixed-size recurrent states, but existing quantizers typically use eight bits or more. Quantization errors persist according to channel decay rates. We derive distortion weights from the observability Gramian and combine them with normalized state ranges for mixed-precision bit allocation, without calibration data, rotation, or training. We also quantize decay rates logarithmically. With per-token state quantization, a four-bit mean payload reduces excess negative log-likelihood by factors of 3.3--27.9 relative to the best of seven baselines across three hybrid models; metadata costs vary. At six bits, negative log-likelihood differs from the FP32-state baseline by less than 0.005 nats. Ablations separate gains from variable bit widths, decay weighting, and range normalization. With less frequent write-backs, gains diminish and depend on the model and budget.

papers.title_en: FoldQuantVLA: Native Low-Bit Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models via Consistent Folding
papers.authors: Hung T. Ho, Khanh D. Nguyen, Quang D. Nguyen, Thanh Q. Duong, Ngan Le, Meng Guo, Vien A. Ngo, An T. Le
papers.evidence: 视觉-语言-动作模型的W4A4原生低比特训练后量化
papers.tldr: 低比特视觉-语言-动作推理需在保持机器人行为的同时降低观测到动作的延迟。FoldQuantVLA 提出训练后量化框架，通过一致折叠在标定、权值舍入与原生整数执行间保持一致的激活表示，结合通道缩放、块 Hadamard 变换与动态逐 token 量化，无需策略重训练。在 GR00T 与 π0.5 上，W4A4 于 Orin 提速 1.20–1.33 倍，桌面提速 1.25–1.52 倍；将语言注意力输出与 FFN 下投影保留 8 比特后，真实机器人成功率从 80.0% 升至 92.5%。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit vision-language-action inference must reduce observation-to-action latency while preserving robot behavior. We present FoldQuantVLA, a post-training quantization framework that carries a consistent activation representation through calibration, weight rounding, and native integer execution. It combines channel scaling and block Hadamard transforms with dynamic per-token quantization, without policy retraining. Custom TensorRT plugins execute projections in both the language backbone and iterative action expert with four-bit weights and activations (W4A4) on Ada GPUs and Jetson AGX Orin. Evaluation spans LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and two robot platforms. Across three GR00T checkpoints and $π_{0.5}$, W4A4 achieves $1.20$ to $1.33\times$ speedups over floating-point TensorRT on Orin and $1.25$ to $1.52\times$ on desktop. Retaining language attention-output and feed-forward down projections at eight bits (W8A8) improves held-out action fidelity on all four checkpoints. Across four real-robot tasks, this configuration raises observed GR00T N1.7 success from $80.0\%$ with uniform W4A4 to $92.5\%$ over 80 trials per configuration, with a measured additional Orin latency of 1 ms.

papers.title_en: Paging the Experts: A Reproducible Characterization of Flash-Backed MoE Inference on iPhone
papers.evidence: 使用量化检查点的MoE推理，专家权重存储于设备
papers.tldr: MoE推理需常驻全部专家，端侧内存受限。作者提出Routide，用Swift/MLX在iPhone上运行Qwen3.6-35B-A3B量化模型文本路径，专家权重放存储、按字节预算缓存部分到内存。在五个128-token工作负载上，512MiB LRU固定路由命中0.00%，同预算随机驱逐18.80%，576MiB LRU达38.58%，表明容量悬崖是策略与负载交互。Mac对照复现2,560次token比较，并记录iOS内存峰值与热停事件。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse activation reduces mixture-of-experts computation without eliminating the need to store all experts. We present Routide, a Swift/MLX runtime that executes the text path of a pinned public Qwen3.6-35B-A3B quantized checkpoint while keeping expert weights in iPhone storage and a byte-budgeted subset in memory. We characterize cache-policy sensitivity, numerical comparison boundaries, and measurement limits. Across five recorded 128-token workloads, fixed-route replay gives 0.00% demand hits with a 512 MiB LRU cache, 18.80% with seeded random eviction at the same budget, and 38.58% with 576 MiB LRU. The apparent capacity cliff is therefore a policy/workload interaction, not a universal memory requirement. Same-runtime Mac controls preserve generated sequences across eviction and asynchronous prefetch, including 2,560 exact token comparisons and 10,334 speculative loads. In contrast, complete resident-Python versus recorded-phone sequences disagree on all five tested cases, precluding a general numerical equivalence claim. Two separately scoped iOS 27 memory protocols observe sampled process-footprint peaks of 1.87-2.32 GiB on short prompts and 2.39-2.73 GiB on one longer prompt. We retain a thermal stopping event, negative timing comparisons, and a single qualified whole-device power estimate. These results establish bounded feasibility and identify limitations that a deployment claim must not hide.

papers.title_en: Quantizing Looped Transformers: Feedback Exposure and Calibration Blindness
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer的低比特训练后量化
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer复用权重，低比特量化极具吸引力，但标准PTQ存在反馈暴露与校准盲区两类失效。Huginn-3.5B的INT4主要损伤无残差的循环入口适配器，误差会在后续步回灌；一步GPTQ仅用第0步激活，忽略后续输入方向。将GPTQ Hessian跨循环步累积后，在七个循环架构九个检查点上均优于一步GPTQ与RTN，并在Huginn恢复bf16级精度。
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers reuse weights across recurrence steps, making low-bit quantization especially attractive. We identify two distinct failure modes of standard post-training quantization. On Huginn-3.5B, per-channel INT4 fails primarily at the non-residual loop-entry adapter, while quantizing the residual core is much less damaging. We call this feedback exposure: a quantized layer perturbs the recurrent state without an identity path, and the resulting error is fed back at later steps. Controlled experiments on linear filters and Mamba state-space models show that feedback exposure also occurs outside transformers. Grouped INT4 reveals a separate failure, calibration blindness: our one-step GPTQ baseline builds its Hessian from step-0 activations, leaving input directions used later in the recurrence nearly unweighted. Across nine checkpoints from seven looped architectures, one-step GPTQ is worse than round-to-nearest (RTN) on the primary task metric for five checkpoints. Accumulating the GPTQ Hessian across recurrence steps outperforms both one-step GPTQ and RTN on all nine checkpoints and recovers bf16-level accuracy on Huginn. These results separate two questions for PTQ on looped models: where quantization error enters the recurrence, and which states calibration sees.

papers.title_en: Generalization behavior of OPTQ and the role of regularization
papers.evidence: 神经网络权重量化与误差界
papers.tldr: 大神经网络可通过权重量化压缩，但OPTQ在未见测试点上的泛化误差尚不明确。本文在泛化框架下分析OPTQ及随机OPTQ，针对固定测试分布推导期望平方误差上界。一个结果将泛化误差与独立同分布校准集误差关联，另一个结果对足够好的分布给出与校准集无关的随机OPTQ界。研究揭示正则项λ的关键作用，并据此提出λ选择建议，实验优于既有方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large neural networks can be compressed by rounding or "quantizing" their weights to numbers that admit representations with fewer bits. One algorithm for quantization, OPTQ, progressively quantizes the weights of a neural network so that the squared quantization error on a specified calibration dataset is as small as possible. We study the performance of OPTQ and a variant algorithm, stochastic OPTQ, in a generalization setting and derive bounds for the expected squared error accrued by the algorithm when a test point is drawn from a fixed distribution. We prove two results. One result relates the generalization error to the error on a calibration dataset comprising independent samples from the same distribution as the test distribution. The other result bounds the generalization error of stochastic OPTQ for all sufficiently nice distributions, regardless of the calibration dataset. In both of these results, the regularization term $λ$ plays an important role. We use insights from these results to make a new recommendation for the choice of $λ$ and see that this choice of $λ$ preforms favorably in experiments when compared to prior recommendations in the literature.
